app.title: OIKOS
app.loadFailed: Your data could not be loaded right now.

update.title: New version
update.ready: A new version of OIKOS is ready. It will install when you choose: whatever you are typing stays on screen until then.

signIn.title: Enter the Archipelago
signIn.intro: Enter your email address and we will send you a sign-in link. No password needed.
signIn.sent: Link sent to {{email}}. Open it on this device to continue.
signIn.failed: The email could not be sent. Try again in a moment.

createHouse.title: Found your house
createHouse.intro: You land as a metic in the city that welcomes you. Give your oikos a name and a blazon.
createHouse.name: House name
createHouse.nameHint: 3 to 24 characters: letters, spaces, apostrophes and hyphens.
createHouse.cityHint: Each city has its patron god and its land: the raw-material productions that can be started there. Workshops are allowed everywhere.

home.title: House {{name}}
home.recipeChanged: Production changed: {{site}}. A new cycle begins.
home.limitReached: Your house already runs as many sites as its headquarters allows.
home.alreadyAcquired: This site was already acquired: {{site}}, for {{cost}}. Nothing more was paid.
home.acquireUnanswered: The response to an acquisition was lost, and one more site now appears in the list. Check it before trying again: another attempt would be a new purchase.
home.upkeep: Upkeep: {{cost}} a day, charged at the daily close
home.halted: Halted since {{date}}: upkeep unpaid. This site no longer produces.
home.retired: Stopped: its production no longer exists. This site produces nothing; choose another production for it.
home.haltedNow: Halted while you were here, upkeep unpaid at the daily close: {{list}}.
home.restarted: Site restarted: {{site}}, for {{cost}} of upkeep and wages.
home.alreadyRestarted: This site was already restarted: {{site}}, for {{cost}}. Nothing more was paid.
home.held: plus {{amount}} held for your resting buy orders at the agora
home.harvestFull: Cap reached: this site produces nothing more until it is collected.
home.openOrdersNone: No open orders at the agora.
home.harvestFullShort: Cap reached: this site produces nothing more until it gets its inputs.
home.outOfTerroir: This production is no longer in the city's land: the site keeps it, but after a change it cannot go back to it.

agora.title: Agora of {{city}}
agora.cancelled: Sale cancelled: {{quantity}} × {{good}} back in free stock.
agora.boughtPartly: Partial purchase: {{quantity}} × {{good}} out of {{wanted}} for {{amount}}. The rest is waiting in the book; the escrow holds {{held}} to pay for it.
agora.boughtShort: Partial purchase: {{quantity}} × {{good}} out of {{wanted}} for {{amount}}. Your treasury could neither pay for more nor hold the price of the rest.
agora.bidsCaption: Resting buy orders, highest bid first
agora.cancelledBuy: Purchase cancelled: {{quantity}} × {{good}}; {{amount}} returned to your treasury.
agora.soldPartly: Partly sold: {{quantity}} × {{good}} out of {{wanted}} for {{amount}}. The rest is waiting in the book.
agora.placedBuy: Buy order waiting: {{quantity}} × {{good}} at {{price}}. The escrow holds {{held}} until it is filled or cancelled.
agora.soldPartlyGross: Partly sold: {{quantity}} × {{good}} out of {{wanted}} for {{amount}} before market tax. The rest is waiting in the book.
agora.expectedNet: Expected net: {{net}} ({{gross}} less {{tax}} in market tax), if the sale is filled in a single trade. Filled in several trades, it may bring in a few obols less.
agora.priceEmpty: No price to show yet: the history is updated at each tick, from the trades.
agora.changeUnknown: 24 h change: unknown, the history is too short.
agora.chartLabel_one: Candlesticks: {{good}}, {{count}} period, from {{from}} to {{to}}, prices in obols from {{low}} to {{high}}. The price table gives the same values.
agora.chartLabel_other: Candlesticks: {{good}}, {{count}} periods, from {{from}} to {{to}}, prices in obols from {{low}} to {{high}}. The price table gives the same values.
agora.chartLegend: Hollow body: closed higher. Filled body: closed lower. Single line: closed where it opened. Logarithmic scale, in obols: {{low}} to {{high}}.
agora.observedPrice: Average price over {{hours}} h, in obols: {{price}} (volume traded: {{volume}}).
agora.observedPriceDated: Last average price computed, as of {{date}}, in obols: {{price}} (volume traded in {{hours}} h: {{volume}}).

accounts.title: Accounts of house {{name}}
accounts.escrow: Escrow (held for your resting buy orders)
accounts.stockValue: Stocks, at the observed average price
accounts.unpriced_one: {{count}} stock with no observed price is not counted.
accounts.unpriced_other: {{count}} stocks with no observed price are not counted.
accounts.stocksIntro: Each stock, including the part on sale, is valued at the last average price observed at the agora of its city.

income.title: Income statement
income.intro: On a cash basis: income or an expense counts on the day money changes hands; an expense is negative. A game day starts at the daily close.
income.empty: No money moved over these periods.

city.title: City of {{city}}
city.intro: The city's inhabitants buy at the agora. At each daily close, the population grows if its vital needs were well enough covered the day before; otherwise some of them emigrate.
city.empty: The city's population is not known yet: it will be from the city's first market day.
city.coverage: Vital needs {{percent}} covered at the last close
city.coverageUnknown: Vital needs coverage not measured yet

cityIdentity.title: City identity
cityIdentity.missing: This city's identity is not known to the configuration in force.
